profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft | Interactive Media, Sound, Video & AI
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Microsoft building automation, AI, and operational platforms for hyperscale datacenter infrastructure.
Started as a datacenter technician in 2017, which gave me a firsthand view of how hardware, software, and operations intersect at global scale.
Alongside infrastructure engineering, I explore interactive media, video, audio, 3D visualization, AI-assisted workflows, and human-computer interaction. Recent projects include Microsoft Global Hackathon award-winning work spanning AI-powered operations, knowledge systems, digital twins, and interactive experiences.
Interested in how AI can make complex systems easier to understand, learn, and operate through better interfaces, contextual guidance, and new forms of interaction.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Built award-winning Microsoft Global Hackathon projects spanning AI agents, knowledge systems, digital twins, interactive experiences, and workflow orchestration.
- Built event-driven platforms, AI-powered tools, and automation systems that streamline operations across Microsoft’s hyperscale infrastructure.
- Developed topology-aware copilots, digital twin experiences, and intelligent workflows that help engineers understand, investigate, and operate complex systems.
- Created observability and analytics solutions using Kusto, Azure Monitor, and Grafana, improving visibility, operational awareness, and decision-making.
- Designed and shipped internal applications across React, Python, Azure Functions, and cloud-native services, combining engineering, UX, and AI-driven experiences.
- Led end-to-end delivery practices including CI/CD, platform engineering, and operational automation using Azure DevOps and Azure services.
positions.insights: Azure Logic Apps, Kusto Query Language (KQL) and +3 skills

positions.title: Service Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop internal applications and automation workflows to support Azure datacenter operations using Power Platform, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual effort.
• Create operational reports and dashboards using Power BI, SQL, and Kusto (KQL), increasing data visibility and enabling faster decision-making.
• Implement REST integrations and automation workflows connecting internal operational systems, improving process continuity and reducing repetitive tasks.
• Structure CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows using Azure DevOps and Git, increasing deployment consistency and accelerating delivery cycles.

positions.title: Data Center Technician
positions.description:
• Supported Azure cloud infrastructure deployment and operations.
• Automated operational processes with PowerApps, Azure, and SQL tools.
• Built internal tools for incident management and logistics tracking.

positions.title: Data Center Technician (Microsoft)
positions.locationName: São Paulo e Região, Brasil · On-site
positions.description:
• Supported datacenter hardware deployment and break/fix operations.
• Coordinated vendor repairs and infrastructure maintenance.

positions.title: Support Analyst (Walmart Project)
positions.description:
• Investigated and fixed data discrepancies in SQL Server databases.
• Wrote T-SQL queries and stored procedures supporting retail reporting and operations.
• Provided production support for a C#/.NET order-processing application connecting Walmart Bentonville with distribution centers in Southern Brazil.

positions.title: System Operator
positions.locationName: São Paulo e Região, Brasil · On-site
positions.description: • Monitored enterprise infrastructure and coordinated incident response for production systems.

honors.title: Microsoft Global Hackathon 2025 - AI Entrepreneurship Executive Challenge Winner - 1st Place
honors.description: Awarded by The Microsoft Garage in recognition of contributing to a 1st place project in the AI Entrepreneurship Executive Challenge at Microsoft Global Hackathon 2025. I spearheaded the creative application of Azure AI Foundry to architect a next-generation ERP system tailored for creative professionals, bridging the gap between complex resource planning and intuitive, AI-driven creative workflows.

honors.title: Microsoft Change Agent Nonprofit Champion Badge
honors.description: Earned the Microsoft Change Agent Nonprofit Champion Badge for serving as an employee volunteer and dedicated advocate for nonprofit initiatives, helping advance their mission through Microsoft Philanthropies resources, technology, digital skills, and employee giving.

volunteerExperiences.description: Supported volunteer initiatives in partnership with Evolua Sumaré STEM School in Brazil, Nuevo Foundation Seattle, and Microsoft US, helping deliver educational programs, workshops, and school-based events for underserved Latino children and youth in the United States and Brazil. Contributed to digital inclusion, technology education, and community outreach efforts that expanded access to opportunity

projects.title: AudioForge Records
projects.description:
Building AudioForge Records 0→1 and architecting Azure cloud infrastructure
• Implementing AI automation workflows.
• Applying modern SDLC practices.
• Researching music market intelligence.
• Developing e-commerce strategy.
